environment: Linux isolated Xvfb, D-Bus, XDG state/runtime; real systemd user service and Flowmux/VTE
checks: agent run starts an independent user service; list and invalid launches do not start a Host
real Flowmux/VTE shows Host-owned alternate screen and round-trips Hangul input
dense sub-MiB JSON requests are rejected before dispatch; the same Agent and live VTE accept fresh Hangul input
opening narrow Background history bounds resize peak and preserves identity, fresh input and the original agent
aggregate memory admission refuses new output-heavy agents, preserves live input, and reuses retired reservations
unterminated synchronized output reaches live VTE without further output or process replacement
synchronized Unicode flood stays bounded on the hidden screen and live VTE accepts fresh input
oversized hyperlink URI and ID flood stays below 32 MiB RSS growth and fresh input works
valid hyperlink projection stays bounded while live VTE and fresh input preserve the same process
retained valid link flood stays below 24 MiB RSS growth and the same process accepts fresh input
title stack flood stays below 32 MiB RSS growth and fresh input works
oversized unterminated OSC is discarded and live VTE resumes output and input
replacement abort before ready preserves the original GUI location, input and exact execution
replacement disconnect before ready preserves the original GUI location, input and exact execution
replacement timeout before ready preserves the original GUI location, input and exact execution
oversized bytes destination checkpoint preserves saved source, authority, exact execution and fresh VTE input
oversized structure destination checkpoint preserves saved source, authority, exact execution and fresh VTE input
post-commit admission ACK disconnect preserves the exact relay, fresh Hangul input and execution without retry
post-commit admission ACK timeout preserves the exact relay, fresh Hangul input and execution without retry
post-commit admission ACK query-timeout preserves the exact relay, fresh Hangul input and execution without retry
closing/reopening and moving an Agent tab with a disconnected relay reconnect the original execution
input backpressure keeps current screen updates flowing and preserves queued input
closing the isolated GUI leaves the same agent/PTY running and progressing
ordinary terminal exits with GUI while managed Agent continues
Host preserves approval waits after GUI exit and applies lifecycle transitions without a GUI; duplicate Stop is inert
headless Working execution survives 1860 real seconds with same PID/birth, continuous progress and one spawn
GUI relay refuses attachment without a registered management connection and preserves execution
saved workspace/pane/tab automatically reconnects the same instance, PID, screen and input; spawn count remains one
SIGKILL of the isolated GUI preserves agent progress and same-process reattachment
stale epoch preserves the binding and reports failure without shell fallback or duplicate launch
lifecycle memory overflow preserves waits, the same process and fresh input; visible uncertainty blocks false completion
duplicate native start cannot erase uncertain work; a new native session restores lifecycle observation
natural agent exit is reaped promptly; empty Host exits and releases its socket
missing Host leaves saved Agent tab disconnected; no Host restart, shell fallback or native resume
